entities.summary: Syeda Maimanat Mohsin, commonly known as Jugnu Mohsin, is a Pakistani politician and journalist. She is closely related to influential feudal and aristocratic business families of the Punjab. Her lineage from the male line is from Tarkhans, as its well known and documented that Hazrat Daud Kirmani their claimed ancestor only had daughters. The female descendants married Tarkhan Mujavir who began claiming Kirmani lineage.
